sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; graphite and gold exploration active. Whyalla steelworks job losses signal industrial metals weakness.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face downward earnings pressure. Small-caps (PLC Resources, Sarytogan, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) offer speculative upside in graphite/gold. Diversify away from iron ore concentration.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring in progress; superannuation system under scrutiny. Fed meeting adds rate uncertainty.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX execution risk on cost plan. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from stable NIM but face credit risk if housing weakens. Super fund flows may shift if reform debate gains traction.

sectors.trend: Australia nears energy inflection point; oil spike lifts fuel prices 30c. LNG and renewables in focus.
sectors.implications: Woods Point (WPU.AX), Origin (ORG.AX), AGL.AX benefit from energy transition narrative. Oil spike pressures Qantas (QAN.AX) and consumer discretionary. Watch LNG export pricing.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator breakup approved; M&A activity accelerating.
sectors.implications: Healthcare consolidation creates acquisition targets. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Monitor hospital operator restructuring for sector-wide implications.

sectors.trend: No spring bounce in auctions; house prices under downward pressure. Young homeowners adapting to falling prices.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX) face occupancy and valuation headwinds. Property developers under pressure. Defensive rotation into income-yielding REITs may be premature.

sectors.trend: AI capex debate intensifies; Foxconn bullish for Nvidia; Anthropic IPO pipeline; Musk robot economy narrative.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but CSL.AX (biotech), SSG.AX, W1.AX benefit from AI-adjacent themes. Global AI sentiment influences risk appetite for ASX small-caps.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with iron ore crash capping upside. Oil spike and Fed meeting create volatility. Energy and small-cap miners outperform; materials and REITs lag. Sentiment cautious.
market_outlook.long_term: Energy transition and healthcare consolidation offer structural themes. Iron ore oversupply and housing correction weigh on GDP. Immigration policy overhaul may support medium-term labour supply but creates near-term uncertainty. Super system reform debate could shift fund flows.
